distribution.summary: 陕西；四川；云南；西藏；台湾
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) establishes mainland records from Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan and Xizang. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds accepted Taiwan occurrence and reports broad China (WP); the broad regional wording is retained as source context and is not converted into provinces.

host_note: The 黄复生等 (2015) host list is retained unchanged. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species broadly as polyphagous on conifers and angiosperms but does not provide resolved host taxa in this entry, so no new host taxon is added.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus raja Blandford, 1893.

nomenclature_note: Current identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Scolytoplatypus raja Blandford, 1893, VSN_5437. Earlier Profile display as Browne, 1962 is a presentation inconsistency and is corrected without changing the stable VSN.
